proposal.summary: Default installation of Lansweeper 6.0.x through 7.2.x enables a Built-in admin account by default, allowing access to Add New Package and Scheduled Deployments features and enabling command execution.
proposal.cwe_quote: By default, everyone in your network can access all of Lansweeper's features and menus simply by browsing to the web console URL and hitting the Built-in Admin button.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify whether the instance uses the Built-in admin account by default and attempt to reproduce access to Add New Package / Scheduled Deployments; if reproducible, disable Built-in admin, apply access restrictions to the web console, and investigate for signs of code execution or compromise.
